campaigns.get.title: Get Campaign
campaigns.get.description: Fetch a single Meta Ads campaign by id via GET /{campaign-id} on Graph API v26.0.

campaigns.create.title: Create Campaign
campaigns.create.description: Create a Meta Ads campaign via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/campaigns. Creates omit effect keys.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in account currency minor units.

lifetimeBudget.description: Lifetime budget in account currency minor units.

isAdsetBudgetSharingEnabled.description: Required by Meta when budgets are at ad set level.

campaigns.update.title: Update Campaign
campaigns.update.description: Update a Meta Ads campaign via POST /{campaign-id}. Reconciles via campaigns.get.

ad_sets.get.title: Get Ad Set
ad_sets.get.description: Fetch a single Meta Ads ad set by id via GET /{adset-id}.

ad_sets.create.title: Create Ad Set
ad_sets.create.description: Create a Meta Ads ad set via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/adsets. Creates omit effect keys.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

ad_sets.update.title: Update Ad Set
ad_sets.update.description: Update a Meta Ads ad set via POST /{adset-id}. Reconciles via ad_sets.get.

ads.get.title: Get Ad
ads.get.description: Fetch a single Meta Ads ad by id via GET /{ad-id}.

ads.create.title: Create Ad
ads.create.description: Create a Meta Ads ad via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/ads. Creates omit effect keys. Ad-level bid_amount write is omitted (deprecated on Marketing API v26.0 Ad; set bid_amount on the ad set).

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

ads.update.title: Update Ad
ads.update.description: Update a Meta Ads ad via POST /{ad-id}. Reconciles via ads.get. Ad-level bid_amount write is omitted (deprecated on Marketing API v26.0 Ad; set bid_amount on the ad set).

ad_creatives.list.title: List Ad Creatives
ad_creatives.list.description: List ad creatives under an ad account via GET /act_{ad-account-id}/adcreatives.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

ad_creatives.get.title: Get Ad Creative
ad_creatives.get.description: Fetch a single ad creative via GET /{creative-id}.

ad_creatives.create.title: Create Ad Creative
ad_creatives.create.description: Create an ad creative via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/adcreatives. Creates omit effect keys.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

insights.get.title: Get Insights
insights.get.description: Fetch sync insights for an ad account, campaign, ad set, or ad via GET /{object-id}/insights.

objectId.description: Graph object id (act_ for accounts when level=account).

timeIncrement.description: Days per bucket, monthly, or all_days.

ad_accounts.get.title: Get Ad Account
ad_accounts.get.description: Fetch a single ad account via GET /act_{ad-account-id}.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

targeting.search.title: Search Targeting
targeting.search.description: Search Meta targeting options via GET /search (interests, geolocations, categories).

locationTypes.description: For adgeolocation: city, country, region, zip.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Meta Ads connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

campaigns.delete.title: Delete Campaign
campaigns.delete.description: Delete a Meta Ads campaign via DELETE /{campaign-id}. Deletes omit effect keys.

ad_sets.delete.title: Delete Ad Set
ad_sets.delete.description: Delete a Meta Ads ad set via DELETE /{adset-id}. Deletes omit effect keys.

ads.delete.title: Delete Ad
ads.delete.description: Delete a Meta Ads ad via DELETE /{ad-id}. Deletes omit effect keys.

ad_creatives.update.title: Update Ad Creative
ad_creatives.update.description: Update a Meta Ads ad creative via POST /{creative-id} (name/status). Reconciles via ad_creatives.get. Poll creative fields are not accepted (v26.0 poll ads deprecation).

ad_creatives.preview.title: Preview Ad Creative
ad_creatives.preview.description: Generate an ad creative preview via GET /{creative-id}/previews. One-shot; omits effect keys.

ad_images.list.title: List Ad Images
ad_images.list.description: List ad images under an ad account via GET /act_{ad-account-id}/adimages.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

ad_images.upload.title: Upload Ad Image
ad_images.upload.description: Upload an ad image via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/adimages (bytes, url, or copy_from). Creates omit effect keys.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

ad_videos.create.title: Create Ad Video
ad_videos.create.description: Create/upload an ad video via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/advideos using file_url. Creates omit effect keys (processing may be async upstream).

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

ad_videos.get.title: Get Ad Video
ad_videos.get.description: Fetch an ad video via GET /{video-id}. Typed replacement for deprecated Composio GET_VIDEO.

custom_audiences.list.title: List Custom Audiences
custom_audiences.list.description: List custom audiences under an ad account via GET /act_{ad-account-id}/customaudiences.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

custom_audiences.get.title: Get Custom Audience
custom_audiences.get.description: Fetch a custom audience via GET /{audience-id}.

custom_audiences.create.title: Create Custom Audience
custom_audiences.create.description: Create a custom audience via POST /act_{ad-account-id}/customaudiences. Creates omit effect keys.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

subtype.description: Audience subtype, e.g. CUSTOM, WEBSITE, LOOKALIKE.

insights.async.create.title: Create Async Insights Report
insights.async.create.description: Start an async insights report via POST /{object-id}/insights with async=true. Async jobs omit effect keys.

objectId.description: Graph object id (act_ for accounts when level=account).

timeIncrement.description: Days per bucket, monthly, or all_days.

insights.async.get.title: Get Async Insights Report Run
insights.async.get.description: Poll an async insights AdReportRun via GET /{report-run-id}. Async job polls omit effect keys.

reach_estimate.get.title: Get Reach Estimate
reach_estimate.get.description: Estimate reach for a targeting spec via GET /act_{ad-account-id}/reachestimate (users_lower_bound/users_upper_bound). One-shot; omits effect keys. Does not use deprecated delivery-estimate fields.

adAccountId.description: Ad account id with or without act_ prefix.

objectStoreUrl.description: Optional app store URL for mobile app campaigns.
